leaves.name: gonzalezRotgerThm512X6
leaves.doc: gr-dict, printed form (degree-and-embedding consequence): Gonzalez-Rotger, J. Math. Soc. Japan 58 (2006), Thm 5.12, p. 946 (read by the locator audit), at (D,N) = (6,1), over CM points as Gonzalez-Rotger define them (GRDict.IsGRCMPoint: the torus C^2/iota(O)(z,1)^T at z in H fixed by an optimal embedding of R), on every witness of the moduli description (no existence claim): [Q(x):Q] = 2h(R) with k in Q(x) if some p | 6 is inert in k, h(R) otherwise. Replaces gonzalezRotgerX6Ab: the witness comes from elkiesX6StarFunctionField and the CM-point dictionary is proved from the textbook fields (GRDict.isGRCMPoint_of_com).
leaves.source: Gonzalez-Rotger, J. Math. Soc. Japan 58 (2006) Thm 5.12, p. 946 (read by the locator audit: Q(P) = H_R if D(R)N*(R) != 1, else the specified index-two subfield) at (D,N) = (6,1); degree and k-embedding clauses, over GR's CM(R) transported to Qbar-points of every coarse witness of X0(6,1)
